application: 1994 Ford F-Series 4.9L comparison; actual truck fan and clutch identity uninspected
selected_clutch: Imperial 215161, 36 mm hex / M30x1.5 right-hand branch
alternative_clutch: Imperial 215155, 40 mm hex / M33x1.5 right-hand branch; same published main envelope and fan mount dimensions, 0.63 inch pilot depth instead of 0.70

sources.title: Imperial fan clutch application and specification catalog
sources.review: Visually reviewed application row and specification headers/drawing B. Both nut-size branches listed for 1994 4.9L; REV means counterclockwise looking at engine from radiator. Metric hex value used explicitly: 36 mm rather than converting the rounded 1.44 inch parallel value.

sources.title: Hayden Fan Clutch Operation and Troubleshooting Guide
sources.review: Front bimetal spring meters silicone fluid between reservoir and working region. Cover illustrations inform general architecture only; they are not a 215161-specific teardown.

sources.title: Dorman 620-151 radiator fan blade specifications and photograph
sources.review: Primary page specifies 7 blades, 18.9 inch OD, black stamped steel, F2UZ8600A direct OE cross. Photograph visually reviewed: separate broad blades attached to a central stamped spider and four clutch attachment holes. Detailed application endpoint returned a challenge page, not usable fit evidence.
Existing saved Ford service procedure specifies separate fan/clutch, pulley and right-hand clutch nut; blade attaches to clutch by bolts.

sourced_clutch_dimensions_mm.rotation: Counterclockwise from radiator looking toward engine

provisional_dimensions_and_construction.limits: Every internal section, clearance, material assignment, valve port, return-flow path, spring calibration, blade pitch/chord/angular spacing and fastener length is provisional. Fluid is not a rigid solid. Sealed clutch decomposition is educational, not a service procedure.

integration.build: fan_clutch.build((define, add, group)) after cooling/pump construction
integration.geometry_status: Changes reconcile existing illustrative pump/pulley interfaces. No production fit established.
